content.text: A single locked-off first-person shot of the military clerk seated at this desk, exactly matching the supplied first frame: same face, clothes, pose, lighting and location. Only this one man remains in the frame throughout. His arms stay resting in their starting position. He looks toward the camera and speaks Mandarin naturally, once: “可以。停手的实据、补报和各自做过的事，一并交来。该追的责任照样追。” Then his lips close. Keep the original composition for the entire shot, with subtle breathing and small eye movements. No other person enters, no new objects enter, no cuts, no camera movement, no subtitles, no music. Soft tent ambience only apart from the specified dialogue.
